title: Talaria v0.6.1 live-test receipt
description: One live case of the v0.6.1 run: the receipt names the frozen head its test ran on, the tester's role, and the evidence inventory — every file beside the receipt with the digest it carried at review. Cross-receipt rules (checklist-item uniqueness, digest and presence verification, the no-waiver READY rule) are enforced by the verifier in scripts/acceptance/v050_receipt.py, not by this shape.

tester.description: A stable role label — a bare word such as tester, worker, or operator. Session and pane names are number-suffixed in this run, so a digit reads as one.

files.description: Every evidence file beside the receipt, keyed by its path relative to the receipt's own directory, valued by its SHA-256 digest.
